page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is a bare-metal class instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 128 dedicated physical cores with a one-to-one thread-to-core ratio, meaning hyperthreading is disabled. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.0 GB of RAM per physical core.

This server integrates four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM. Networking capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. There is no local NVMe or SSD storage bundled with this instance, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data.

Given the high density of dedicated physical cores and the quad-GPU configuration, this instance represents a high-resource tier designed for intensive parallel processing. The lack of local storage means storage costs are externalized, but the high-speed network baseline supports efficient remote storage access. It is suited for workloads such as machine learning inference, distributed graphics rendering, high-performance computing, and large-scale simulation tasks.
